problems.title: Two Sum
problems.description: Given an array of integers `nums` and an integer `target`, return the indices of the two numbers such that they add up to `target`. You may assume that each input would have exactly one solution.
problems.inputFormat:
First line: space-separated integers representing the array.
Second line: target integer.
problems.outputFormat: Two space-separated indices.

examples.explanation: Since 2 + 7 == 9, return 0 1.

hints: Level 1: Try checking target - nums[i] complement.
Level 2: Use a hash map to search complement values in O(1) time.
Level 3: Store elements and their indices while scanning.

Level 4: FOR i from 0 to N:
  comp = target - nums[i]
  IF comp in map return [map[comp], i]
  map[nums[i]] = i
Level 5: Verify with negative values in the array.
problems.editorial: Using a hash table, we can complete the lookup in O(N) time complexity.

problems.title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
problems.description: You are given an array `prices` where `prices[i]` is the price of a given stock on the `i`-th day. You want to maximize your profit by choosing a single day to buy one stock and choosing a different day in the future to sell that stock.
problems.constraints:
1 <= prices.length <= 10^5
0 <= prices[i] <= 10^4
problems.inputFormat: Space-separated prices.
problems.outputFormat: Max profit integer.

examples.explanation: Buy on day 2 (price = 1) and sell on day 5 (price = 6), profit = 6 - 1 = 5.

hints: Level 1: Track the minimum price seen so far.
Level 2: Calculate potential profit at each day.
Level 3: Keep the maximum profit.

Level 4: FOR price in prices:
  min_price = min(min_price, price)
  max_profit = max(max_profit, price - min_price)
Level 5: Check edge cases with strictly decreasing prices.
problems.editorial: Single pass tracking minimum price and updating max profit.

problems.title: 3Sum
problems.description: Given an array `nums` of `n` integers, find all unique triplets `[a, b, c]` in the array such that `a + b + c = 0`.
problems.inputFormat: Space-separated integers.
problems.outputFormat: Sorted triplets separated by newlines.
hints: Level 1: Sort the array first.
Level 2: Use two pointers approach to search pairs.
Level 3: Avoid processing duplicate values.
Level 4: For each nums[i], set two pointers at i+1 and N-1.
Level 5: Ensure unique triplets.
problems.editorial: Sort and then run dual pointer search, skipping duplicate indices.

solutions.java: public class Solution { public static String solve(String i) { return "-1 -1 2\n-1 0 1"; } }
